## GOV-P0-01 draft control extension

The following fields are candidates for mandatory material-work control and do not become operational until BOPEN-GOV-001 is approved:

- authorization source, accepted by and accepted at;
- lifecycle namespace, phase/gate and expiry;
- maker, independent checker and session IDs;
- worktree, branch and exact base commit;
- allowed and prohibited paths;
- evidence destination and rollback;
- completion commit/tree;
- checker verdict and separate authority disposition.
